unmapped_findings: fΔ (area fraction of crack initiation + propagation zones) = 0.74 at 180 MPa (largest among all samples at 180 MPa); = 0.43 at 315 MPa (source: b0041, figure_006).
Fatigue striation morphology for 600-6: at 180 MPa fine striations overlain by a fan-like vein/rib pattern; at 315 MPa dense parallel striations (source: figure_007).
Rapid fracture zone of 600-6 fails by microvoid coalescence (dimple-dominated ductile fracture) at both 180 and 315 MPa (source: b0043, figure_008).

Among aged samples, the intermediate intragranular κ-carbide size (~18 nm) of 600-6 achieves the highest fatigue strength due to a favorable balance of shearing-related strengthening and uniform planar slip (source: b0074).

At high stress amplitudes, fatigue life ranking among aged samples is 550-6 best, 600-6 intermediate, and 650-6 poorest, tracking the increasing severity of intergranular precipitation (source: b0080).
